title: polyscias tahitensis
intro: Polyscias tahitensis, commonly known as Tahitian pepper or Etrog citron, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Polyscias tahitensis include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion due to its bioactive constituents.
